nodes.summary: Let $K$ and $L$ be number fields with $L$ an extension of $K$ that is a Hilbert class field of $K$. If $M$ is a number field that is a finite-dimensional abelian Galois extension of $K$, such that every nonzero prime ideal of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ is unramified in $\mathcal{O}_M$ and every infinite place of $M$ is unramified over $K$, then there is a $K$-algebra homomorphism $M \to L$.
